title: Node.js
simpleMetaphor: Runs JavaScript on the server outside of the web browser.
technicalExplanation: Event-driven asynchronous JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine.

title: Express.js
simpleMetaphor: Minimalist framework on Node.js to quickly create web servers and REST endpoints.
technicalExplanation: Minimalist and flexible Node.js web application framework providing routing and middleware utilities.

title: Bun
simpleMetaphor: Ultra-fast modern replacement for Node.js that includes an integrated package manager.
technicalExplanation: All-in-one JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager written in Zig.

title: Deno
simpleMetaphor: A secure JavaScript and TypeScript runtime created by Node's original creator.
technicalExplanation: Modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript with secure defaults and web-standard APIs.

title: NestJS
simpleMetaphor: An enterprise Node.js framework structured with Angular-like modules and dependency injection.
technicalExplanation: Progressive Node.js framework built with TypeScript for scalable backend server architecture.

title: Fastify
simpleMetaphor: A Node.js web framework focused on extreme speed and low overhead.
technicalExplanation: Fast and low-overhead Node.js web framework inspired by Hapi and Express with schema parsing.

title: Python (FastAPI / Django)
simpleMetaphor: High-level language famous for AI, data analysis, and clean web backends.
technicalExplanation: Versatile programming language powering web frameworks like FastAPI (async APIs) and Django (batteries-included).

title: Go (Golang)
simpleMetaphor: Google's compiled language built for massive concurrency, microservices, and speed.
technicalExplanation: Statically typed, compiled language with built-in concurrency (goroutines) for high-performance servers.
